ပန်းချီသမား။
DOP: 2 citta citra 1 mfn. and n. [ S. citra], 1. ( mfn. ) ( i ) bright, bright-coloured; decorated; many-coloured; extraordinary, wonderful ; Abh 838 (vicitte ~am); Vin II 113, 3 (chabbaggiyā bhikkhū citrāni pattamaṇḍalāni dhārenti rūpakokiṇṇāni bhatikammakatāni); M II 65, 3* (añjanī va navā ~ā pūtikāyo alaṅkato) = Th 773 (Th-a III 36, 11 : yathā añjanī … mālākammamakaradantādivasena ~ā, bahi maṭṭhā ujjalā dassanīyā anto pana na dassanīyā hoti); Dhp 171 (etha passath’ imaṃ lokaṃ ~aṃ rājarathūpamaṃ; Dhp-a III 167, 21 : ~an ti sattaratanādi-vicittaṃ rājarathaṃ viya vatthālaṅkārādicittitaṃ); Vv 36:3 (sovaṇṇamayā lohitaṅkamayā … pārevatakkhīhi maṇīhi °-tā,? Vv-a 167, 22 foll. : pārevatakkhisadisehi maṇīhi yathāvuttamaṇīhi ca saṅkhatacittabhāvā imā tava kesahatthe ratanamālā ti adhippāyo); 47:9 (passa … accheraṃ ~aṃ kammaphalaṃ idaṃ; Vv-a 202, 26 : ~an ti vicittaṃ acinteyyaṃ); 78:4 (citrā manoramā bhūmi na tatth’ uddhaṃsatī rajo); Ja V 417, 1 (Kuṇālo nāma sakuṇo … ativiya ~o ativiya cittapattacchadano; 418, 23´ : ~o ti mukhatuṇḍake heṭṭhā udarabhāge pi citro va); VI 127, 2* (citrā … aṭṭhaṃsā sukatā thambhā; 127, 8´ : citrā ti nānāratanavicitrā); Nidd I 380, 13 (citrā upāhanā; Nidd-a I 413, 4 foll. : suvaṇṇarajatādivicittā morapiñjādi-parikkhatā upāhanā); Ap 113, 24 (vasudhā yathā-ppameyyā ~ā vanavaṭaṃsakā); Mil 1, 10* (Nāgasenakathā citrā opammehi nayehi ca); Sp 1087, 6 (ekam eva upadhānaṃ … rattaṃ vā hotu padumavaṇṇaṃ vā ~aṃ vā); — ( ii ) variegated, speckled ; Abh 99 (kammāso kabaḷo ~o); Vin I 193, 4 (vacchako hoti taruṇako … citro seyyathāpi dīpicchāpo); Ja III 251, 17´ (tasmiṃ kira uyyāne rukkhalatādīnaṃ pabhā tattha paviṭṭha-paviṭṭhānaṃ devānaṃ sarīravaṇṇaṃ ~aṃ karoti, Be, Ee so; Ce, Se citraṃ); V 69, 1* (brāhmaṇam addakkhi setaṃ citraṃ kilāsinaṃ; 69, 17´ : kabarakuṭṭhena citraṃ, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se vicitraṃ); — ( iii ) various, different, manifold ; M II 74, 5* (kāmā hi citrā madhurā) = Sn 50 (Pj II 99, 23 : rūpādi-anekappakāravasena citrā); Ja III 245, 16* (citrāhi gāthāhi subhāsitāhi; 245, 18´ : citrāhī ti anekatthasannissitāhi); VI 211, 8* (~ehi vaṇṇehi mukhaṃ nayanti; 214, 30´ : ayaṃ te yūpo parattha kāmaduho bhavissati sassatabhāvaṃ āvahissatī ti citrehi kāraṇehi mukhaṃ pasārenti); As 64, 12 (evaṃ tāva °-tāya cittaṃ); Mhv 37:247 (katvā puññāni citrāni); — 2. ( m. ) a kind of bird (the speckled cuckoo) ;? Ja VI 276, 15´ (kuṇālakā ti kāḷakokilā, citrā ti citrapattakokilā, ad 276, 12* : kuṇālakā bahū citrā; but rather adj. ? cf Ja V 406, 28´ : kuṇālakā ti kokilā, citrā ti citrapattā); — see also citrakokila below ; — 3. ( n. ) ( i ) something brilliant or diverse or extra-ordinary; a wonder ; S I 22, 24* (na te kāmā yāni citrāni loke saṅkapparāgo purisassa kāmo) ≠ A III 411, 12* (Mp III 407, 8 : citrānī ti citracitrārammaṇāni); Th 674 (bahūni loke citrāni; Th-a III 4, 4 foll. : rūpādivasena tatthāpi nīlapītādivasena itthipurisādi-vasena ca anekāni loke cittavicittāni ārammaṇajatāni); — ( ii ) a painting, a picture ; Abh 838 (cittakamme ~am uccate); S III 151, 24 (diṭṭhaṃ vo bhikkhave caraṇaṃ nāma ~an ti … taṃ …caraṇaṃ nāma ~aṃ citten’ eva cintitaṃ); As 64, 15 (caraṇaṃ nāma ~aṃ aticittam eva hoti); Sadd 538, 30 (cittasaddo … diṭṭhaṃ vo bhikkhave caraṇaṃ namā ~an ti ādisu cittakamme); — ifc see aneka- ( sv eka ), paṭibhāna-, lepa-; — ° âgāra , n. , a decorated pleasure-house ; Vin IV 298, 4 foll. (uyyāne ~e paṭibhānacittaṃ kataṃ hoti, bahū manussā ~aṃ dassanāya gacchanti; Sp 934, 13 ; ~an ti kīḷanacittasālaṃ); Vin-vn 2278 (rājāgāraṃ ~aṃ … daṭṭhuṃ); — (citr)’- aggaḷa , m. , a decorated door-bolt ; Ja VI 483, 5* (citraggaḷe-r-ughusite surāmaṃsappabodhane, instr.pl. ? cf L. Alsdorf, 1957; 483, 20´ foll. : pañcaṅgikaturiyasaddasadisaṃ manoramaṃ ravaṃ ravantehi sattaratanacittehi dvārakavāṭehi ugghosite, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se sattaratanavicittehi); — °’- aṅgada , mfn. , wearing bright or variegated bracelets ; Ja V 400, 12* (kā … ~ā kambuvimaṭṭhadhārinī; 400, 19´ : citrehi aṅgadehi samannāgatā); — °’- atthara , citratthara, n. , a multi-coloured rug ; Ja IV 458, 24 (~e peḷaṃ ṭhapetvā, Se so; Ce, Ee citratthare; Be vicittatthare) = Cp-a 129, 19 ( Ce so; Ee citratthare; Be, Se vicittatthare); — °’- attharaka , citrattharaka, m. , a multi-coloured rug ; Ja VI 191, 20 (~e ratanapeḷaṃ ṭhapetvā, Se so; Ce, Ee citrattharake; Be cittattharaṇe); Spk III 45, 5 (-suriyattharakacittattharakādīhi nānā-vaṇṇehi attharakehi); — °- kata , mfn. , painted; decorated ; M II 64, 25* (passa ~aṃ bimbaṃ arukāyaṃ samussitaṃ) = Dhp 147 = Th 769 (Th-a III 35, 6 : ~an ti cittaṃ kataṃ, cittakataṃ, vatthābharaṇamālādīhi vicittaṃ katan ti attho, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee cittaṃ kataṃ cittīkataṃ); Ps III 302, 18 (gandhādīhi maṇikuṇḍalehi ca ~aṃ pi rūpaṃ vatthehi sah’ eva sobhati, vinā vatthehi jegucchaṃ hoti anolokanakkhamaṃ); Bv-a 62, 6 (vāḷamigā … ukkhittaṃ pādaṃ anikkhipitvā ~ā viya tiṭṭhanti); — °- katha , mfn. , who speaks brilliantly; whose talk is varied ; S I 199, 15* (te ~ā bahussutā); IV 375, 1 (Khemā … bahussutā ~ā kalyāṇapaṭibhānā ti, Be, Ce so; Ee, Se cittakathī, prob. wr ); Thī 449 (sīlavatī ~ā bahussutā, Be, Ce so; Ee, Se wr cittakathikā); — °- kathā , f. , brilliant speech; a varied discourse ; Mp I 285, 13 (dhammakathaṃ kathento … upamāhi ca kāraṇehi ca maṇḍetvā ~am eva katheti, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se cittakathikaṃ); — °- kath(i)n , citrakathi(n), mfn. , speaking brilliantly; whose talk is varied ; D II 317, 9 (paṇḍito vyatto medhāvī bahussuto ~ī kalyāṇapaṭibhāno) = M II 83, 21 ; Vv 84:26; Th 234 (ye ~ī bahussutā samaṇā; Th-a II 93, 4 foll. : vicittadhammakathā … nānā-nayehi paresaṃ ajjhāsayānurūpaṃ dhammassa kathana-sīlā ti attho); Ja III 507, 24* (bahussutaṃ ~iṃ gaṅgā vahati Pāṭalaṃ, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se ~aṃ); VI 222, 24* (suto citrakathī gaṇī); Ap 497, 14 (vaggussaro ~ī para-vādappamaddano); Mil 1, 5* (āsajja rājā citrakathiṃ ukkādhāraṃ tamonudaṃ); — °- kathika , mfn. , speaking brilliantly; whose talk is varied ; A I 24, 28 (etadaggaṃ … mama sāvakanaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ … ~ānaṃ yadidaṃ Kumārakassapo; Mp I 283, 11 : ~ānan ti vicittaṃ katvā dhammaṃ kathentānaṃ) ≠ Ja I 148, 30 ( Be so; Se citra-kathikānaṃ; Ce, Ee citrakathīnaṃ); Ap 545, 6 (nipuṇā ~ā); — °- kamma , n. , a painting, a picture; decoration ; Vin V 129, 33 (~-dānaṃ; Sp 1335, 9 foll. : āvāsaṃ kāretvā tattha ~aṃ kāretuṃ vaṭṭati, idaṃ pana paṭibhāna-cittakammadānaṃ sandhāya vuttaṃ); Ja VI 333, 12 (niṭṭhitāya sālāya cittakāre pakkosāpetvā … ramaṇīyaṃ ~aṃ kāresi); Mil 278, 31 (~-dānaṃ); Vism 38, 18 (manoramaṃ bhante ~an ti); 306, 18 (ākāse ~assa viya … patiṭṭhānaṭṭhānaṃ na hoti); Ps IV 69, 7 (ekadivasen’ eva sattabhūmako pāsādo na sakkā kātuṃ vatthuṃ sodhetvā thambhussāpanato paṭṭhāya yāva ~-karaṇā); As 64, 13 (lokasmiṃ hi ~ato uttariṃ aññaṃ cittaṃ nāma natthi); — ~-kata, mfn. , painted; decorated ; Ja VI 481, 5 (~-katāya viya uracchadamālāya alaṅkatena urena jātattā, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee cittakammena katāya); Sp 1236, 29 (yaṃ kiñci ~-kataṃ); — ~-rūpa, ~-rūpaka, n. , a figure in a painting ; Ja IV 408, 11 (uggatena maṃsa-piṇḍena pūretvā ~-rūpakassa viya akkhīni ahesum) ≠ Cp-a 70, 5 (~-rūpassa, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee cittarūpassa); Sv 448, 18 (mahāpuriso … ~-rūpakaṃ viya ca khāyati); — see also cittarūpa 2 below ; — °- kāra , m. [citta + kāra 1 ], a painter ; Abh 508 (raṅgājīvo ~o); S II 101, 31 (~o … itthirūpaṃ vā purisarūpaṃ vā abhinimmineyya, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se cittakārako; = III 152, 10 : °-kārako); Ja VI 333, 12 (niṭṭhitāya sālāya ~e pakkosāpetvā … ramaṇīyaṃ cittakammaṃ kāresi); Ps II 183, 17 (tāni ~ena tūlikaggena paricchinnāni viya ahesuṃ); As 64, 15 (~ānaṃ evaṃvidhāni ettha rūpāni kātabbānī ti cittasaññā uppajjati); Vibh-a 331, 25 (yathā … cheko ~o rūpaṃ likhitukāmo ādito va bhittiparikammaṃ karoti tato aparabhāge rūpaṃ samuṭṭhāpeti); Mhv 32:4 (~ehi kāresi vedikaṃ); — cittakāro in Ee at Ps V 74, 17 is wr for cittīkāro ( Be, Ce, Se so ); — °- kāraka , m. , a painter ; S II 101, 31 (~o … itthirūpaṃ vā purisarūpaṃ vā abhi-nimmineyya, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee cittakāro) = III 152, 10 ; — °- keḷi , f. , ( and °-keḷiyā?) various sports, amusements ;? ( or to citta 1 qv ?) Ja III 43, 21 (te paresaṃ rakkhitagopite mātugāme aparajjhitvā ~iṃ kīḷantā bahuṃ pāpakammaṃ katvā); Sp 512, 5 (kāyavācīdvārehi asaññato bhinnājīvo ~iṃ kīḷanto vicari; cf Sp-ṭ [ Be ] II 295, 15 : ~in ti cittaruciyaṃ taṃ taṃ kīḷanto) ≠ Spk II 222, 16 ( Be, Ce, Ee so; Se cittakīḷaṃ); Sp 1011, 16 (~iyaṃ kīḷituṃ palāto ti, eds so ); — (citra)- kokila , m. , the speckled cuckoo ; Ja V 416, 6 foll. (dve citrakokilā … aṭṭha citrakokilā … taṃ citrakokilaṃ parivāretvā, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee aṭṭha cittakokilā); Ap-a 519, 14 (citrakokilo hutvā nibbatto); — °- gu , citragu, mfn. [citra + gu 3 ], possessing speckled cows ; Bv-a 32, 18 (uttamasatto ti visesanassa pubbanipātapāṭhato ~ū paddhagū ti ettha viyā ti nāyaṃ doso); Sadd 774, 28 (citrā gāvo yassa kulassa taṃ kulaṃ citragu); — °- geṇḍuka , citra-geṇḍuka, m. [citta + geṇḍuka 1 ], a brightly-coloured ball ; Ja V 196, 2 (rājadhītaraṃ … tantubaddhaṃ ~aṃ gāhāpetvā, Be so; Se citrageṇḍukaṃ; Ce wr citra-bheṇḍukaṃ; Ee wr cittabheṇḍukaṃ); 196, 24´ (citra-geṇḍukassa adiṭṭhapubbattā rukkhaphalena tena bhavitabban ti maññamāno, Be, Se so; Ce wr citra-bheṇḍukassa; Ee wr citrabheṇḍukena); — (citra)- chattā in Ee at Ja VI 540, 4´ is wr; Ce, Se citrapattā; Be vicitrapattā; — (citra)- chada , mfn. , with variegated wings ; Th 1108 (citrachadā vihaṅgamā; Th-a III 154, 17 foll. : vicitrapekhuṇapakkhino, mayūrā ti attho); — (citra)- taṇḍulā , f. , a plant; SAF: embelia, Embelia ribes Burm.f. ; Abh 586 (viḷaṅgaṃ citrataṇḍulā); — °- tara , mfn. , more variegated or diverse; more extra-ordinary ; S III 151, 28 (tena … caraṇena cittena cittaṃ yeva ~aṃ; Spk II 327, 26 : tassa cittassa upāyapariyesana-cittaṃ tato pi ~aṃ); 152, 5 (tehi pi … tiracchānagatehi pāṇehi cittaṃ yeva ~aṃ); As 64, 26 ; — °- tilaka , m. [citta + tilaka 1 ], an ornamental or sectarian mark on the forehead ; Nidd-a I 20, 28 foll. (ath’ assa nalāṭe ekam eva manosilābinduṃ kareyya tassa na ettāvatā ~o nāma hoti, nānāvaṇṇehi pana parivāretvā bindusu katesu ~o nāma hoti) ≠ As 138, 31 foll. ; — see also cittaka 2 ; — °- paṭa , m. , coloured cloth; a painting ; It-a I 140, 34 (dūrato ~aṃ pekkhantassa viya, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee wr cittapaṭipekkhantassa); Th-a I 211, 26 (~e buddhacaritaṃ suvaṇṇapatte ca paṭiccasamuppādaṃ likhāpetvā); — °- patatti(n) , mfn. , with variegated wings ; Ja VI 590, 19* (sakuṇī mānusinī va jātā ~inī … rājaputtī asobhatha, so read ? Ce, Ee, Se cittapattā pati; Be cittapattā patī; cf 590, 34´ foll. : yathā manussasarīrena jātā mānusinī nāma sakuṇī cittapattā ākāse uppatamānā pakkhe pasāretvā gacchantī sobhati evaṃ …); — °- (p)patta , citrapatta, mfn. [citta + patta 2 ], with variegated feathers ; Ja VI 540, 4 (citrapattā, Ce, Se so; Be vicitrapattā; Ee wr citrachattā); 591, 1´ (sakuṇī ~ā); — cittapattā patī̆ in eds at Ja VI 590, 19* is wr (unmetrical), perhaps for citta-patattinī); — °- pattacchadana , mfn. , with a covering of variegated feathers ; Ja V 417, 1 (sakuṇo … ativiya citto ativiya ~o); — see also sucittapattacchadana below ; — °- pāṭalī , citrapāṭalī, f. , a kind of tree ; S V 238, 16 (ye keci asurānaṃ rukkhā ~ī tesaṃ aggam akkhāyati); Ja I 202, 15 (devānaṃ pāricchattako viya ~ī nāma kappaṭṭhiya-rukkho hoti); Vism 206, 19 (asurānaṃ citrapāṭaliyā) = As 298, 28 (~iyā); Bv-a 168, 20 (sudassananagaradvāre ~iyā mūle yamakapāṭihāriyaṃ katvā); — °- puññaṃ in Ee at Ap 552, 4 is prob. wr; Be cittaṃ muñjaṃ; Ce, Se cittamuñjaṃ; — (citra)- pekhuṇa , °-pekhuna, °-pekkhuṇa, °-pekkhuna, mfn. , with variegated tail-feathers ; Ja I 207, 10 (maṇivaṇṇagīvaṃ citrapekhuṇaṃ moraṃ disvā, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se citrapekkhuṇaṃ); VI 497, 16* (yadā morīhi parikiṇṇaṃ aṇḍajaṃ citrapekkhunaṃ moraṃ dakkhisi, Ce, Ee, Se so; Be citrapakkhinaṃ); 539, 6* (sakuṇā … aṇḍajā citrapekhuṇā, Be so; Ce citrapekkhuṇā; Ee citrapekhunā; Se citrapekkhaṇā; 540, 3´ foll. : aṇḍena jātā citrapattā, Ce, Se so; Be vicitrapattā; Ee wr citrachattā); 564, 22* (mayūrā citrapekhuṇā, Be, Se so; Ce citrapekkhuṇā; Ee cittapekkhanā); — °- phalika , m. , speckled crystal ; Ud-a 302, 32 (masāragallan ti kabaramaṇi, ~an ti pi vadanti, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee masāragallaṃ pana kabaracittaphalikan ti vadanti); — (citra)- bimbamukhī , ( m ) f ( n )., with painted or decorated bodies and faces ;? Ja V 452, 29* (tā upenti vividhena chandasā citra-bimbamukhiyo alaṅkatā; 454, 32´ foll. : alaṅkāravasena citrasarīrā vicitramukhiyo va hutvā); — °- bheṇḍuka , citrabheṇḍuka in Ce, Ee at Ja V 196, 2 and 196, 24´ are wrr for °-geṇḍuka, citrageṇḍuka qqv ; — (citra)- miga , m. , the spotted antelope ; Ja VI 538, 25´ (citrakā cāpi dīpiyo ti citramigā ca dīpimigā ca, Ce, Ee so; Be citrakamigā; Se vicitramigā); — °- rūpa 1 , mfn. and n. , 1. ( mfn. ) very extraordinary, wonderful; very varied ; Ja IV 98, 2* (tapo nu te brāhmaṇa bhiṃsarūpo, mantā nu te brāhmaṇa ~ā; 99, 14´ : udāhu vicitrarūpā sabbattha-sādhakā mantā te atthi); Mp V 24, 16 (~-sadiso hutvā pañcakappasatāni tiṭṭhati); — see also sucittarūpa below ; — 2. ( n. ) a very strange thing, a wonder ; Ja VI 512, 18* (~aṃ va dissati) = Cp-a 86, 5* (86, 8 : ~aṃ vā ti acchariyarūpaṃ viya); — °- rūpa 2 , n. , a painted figure, a figure in a painting ; Cp-a 70, 5 (akkhīni … uggatena maṃsapiṇḍena pūretvā ~assa viya ruhiṃsu, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se °-kammarūpassa); 125, 10 (soḷasehi nāgakaññā-sahassehi ~aṃ viya paricāriyamāno devalokasampatti-sadise nāgalokissariye ṭhito pi?); — see also cittakammarūpa above ; — °- saññā , f. , the idea of or for a picture ; ( or to citta 1 : a mental concept, a creative idea; see A.K. Coomaraswamy, 1931, p. 218 ); As 64, 15 foll. ([caraṇaṃ] karontānaṃ cittakārānaṃ evaṃvidhāni ettha rūpāni kātabbānī ti ~ā uppajjati, tāya ~āya lekhāgahaṇarañjana-ujjotanavattanādinipphādikā cittakiriyā uppajjanti, Be, Ce so; Se -nipphāditā; Ee uppajjati, cittāya saññāya lekhāya, prob. wr );
